question: Should Control UI assistant-message copy use a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, a persisted default copy-format preference, or remain Markdown-only for now?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the permanent UX and conversion contract affect user-facing chat behavior and may add persisted preference surface if implemented as a default setting.

options.title: Add per-click copy-format menu
options.body: Add a small copy-button menu with Markdown and plain-text actions, avoiding a new stored preference while satisfying the reporter's main use case.

options.title: Add persisted copy preference
options.body: Add a user preference for the default copy format, but only if maintainers explicitly want the extra settings surface and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave Markdown-only copy in place until maintainers prioritize broader chat export/copy ergonomics.

recommendation.title: Add per-click copy-format menu
recommendation.body: Add a small copy-button menu with Markdown and plain-text actions, avoiding a new stored preference while satisfying the reporter's main use case.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the existing copy-as-markdown behavior and has the clearest history signal for the Control UI copy path.
